subject: Logic
title: Whataboutism
description: A fast breakdown of Whataboutism for builders.

hook.text: "Your country has human rights problems." "What about your country's problems?" Deflection complete.

buildup.text: Whataboutism counters criticism by pointing to someone else's wrongs instead of addressing the issue.

discovery.text: Soviet diplomats perfected it during the Cold War. Every accusation met with "And you lynch Negroes."

twist.text: Both sides can have problems simultaneously. Pointing at theirs doesn't fix yours.

climax.text: A valid critique stands on its own merits regardless of the critic's flaws.

punchline.text: Their wrong doesn't make yours right.

quiz.question: What does whataboutism do?
options: Deflects by pointing to others' flaws
